meta.title: BricoMission
meta.description: Turn photos of your kitchen into photorealistic designs and a budget priced from real catalogs.

home.headline: Design your new kitchen and know its price before you start.
home.valueProposition: Upload photos and measurements of your kitchen. See photorealistic designs, get a budget priced from real store catalogs, then do it yourself or receive offers from validated professionals.

capture.title: 1. Capture
capture.description: Photos of your kitchen and its measurements.

design.title: 2. Design
design.description: Photorealistic designs that keep your room's layout.

budget.title: 3. Budget
budget.description: Four price levels from real catalogs. Do it yourself or get offers.

language.title: Choose your language
